name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea, improvement, or new app/component for this homelab
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem or Motivation

Is this request related to a problem, a gap you noticed, or just something you think would be a good addition? Please describe. (e.g. "The CI pipeline doesn't cover Terraform/Ansible, so...")

## Proposed Solution

A clear, concise description of what you'd like to see happen.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered, and why you didn't propose those instead.

## Scope

Which layer would this touch? [Terraform / Ansible / Kubernetes manifest / CI / documentation]

## Additional Context

Anything else - links to relevant tools/projects, prior art in other homelab repos, screenshots/mockups if applicable.
